connector.name: Leadbay
connector.registryDescription: AI lead discovery, qualification, and outreach prep on your Leadbay account.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.leadbay.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the leadbay account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LEADBAY_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token, set by the installer. Run `npx -y -p @leadbay/mcp@latest installer` and sign in with your browser.

env.name: LEADBAY_REGION
env.description: us or fr - Leadbay backend that owns your account.

env.name: LEADBAY_MCP_WRITE
env.description: Set to 0 to hide composite write tools (default: 1, ON).

env.name: LEADBAY_MCP_ADVANCED
env.description: Set to 1 to expose granular API tools.

env.name: LEADBAY_TELEMETRY_ENABLED
env.description: Product-usage telemetry (PostHog/Sentry). Set to false to opt out. On a local/stdio install this env var is the ONLY way to stop telemetry — the account-level toggle (leadbay_set_telemetry) governs the hosted connector, not a local process (default: true).

recipes.cli: claude mcp add leadbay --env LEADBAY_TOKEN=<your-leadbay-token> --env LEADBAY_REGION=fr --env LEADBAY_MCP_WRITE=1 --env LEADBAY_MCP_ADVANCED=0 --env LEADBAY_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=true -- npx -y -y @leadbay/mcp@0.27 @leadbay/mcp@0.27.0

recipes.code:

command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "-y", "@leadbay/mcp@0.27", "@leadbay/mcp@0.27.0"]
